Public getters expose immutable data. doorway_approaches slices regions[1..] only for single-building treatment, relying on admitted first-bearing shape; contains uses convex half-plane tests over outlines and intersects_disc uses native distance_outside with raw centre/radius. Actual validate_encoded cardinality/shape and disc caller/native radius domains remain Q-L12-526d08f49c4c2715556f and related ownership scope. rejection builds typed diagnostic location and unit-selected comparison, preserving property/members/treatment. Compound support_surface builds mesh, fallible floor records, regions and source outlines into a local candidate, retains Floor construction errors, then admits generated geometry. This completes the actual selected-path join to final validation without granting source coverage or correctness for validate_encoded/FloorBearing providers.
